items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: Last time I saw Mac, Mac came and seen me and told me he was here working at the Western Union's office.

ctx.x: Well, I'll ask Thomas. He'll know.

Yeah. That's Thomas. He looked just like Thomas. He looked just like Thomas. He was talking about his brother. And Mac was here. Mac was here working at the Western Union's office, I believe. Last time I saw Mac, Mac came and seen me and told me he was here working at the Western Union's office. I don't know what Mac is because I'm going to run down on him no more since.
Well, I thought he just had that show. I'm thinking about Billy Mac. Is that the same?
